# Projects in graph-manager: store, folder, routes and the Projects page

## What to build

A **project** is a saved, named group of at least two workspaces from one forge, with its own folder (spec goal **MR-01**, section "graph-manager: projects (MR-01)"). This task builds it end to end in `apps/graph-manager`:

- **Store**: `projects: Record<id, { name, workspaces: string[], createdAt }>` in `graph-manager.json` (`src/server/store.ts`), defaulting to `{}` so old files load.
- **Folder** (new `src/server/projects.ts`): `<workspacesDir>/.projects/<id>/` is a local git repo (`git init`, never a remote) holding `project.json` (`{ name, repos: [{ name, path: "repos/<name>" }] }`), `repos/<name>` links to each workspace (a `"junction"` on Windows, a `"dir"` symlink elsewhere), a `.gitignore` with `repos/` and `.graph-execution/`, and a first commit. Editing the repos rewrites `project.json` and the links and commits; deleting removes the folder, never a workspace.
- **Routes** (new `src/server/routes/projects.ts`, behind login): `GET /api/projects`, `POST /api/projects { name, workspaces }`, `PATCH /api/projects/:id { workspaces }`, `DELETE /api/projects/:id`, with the status codes below; and `DELETE /api/workspaces/:id` answers 409 `workspace is part of project <name>` while a project uses it.
- **UI**: a Projects page (`/projects`, nav item **Projects** right after Workspaces) listing projects with their repos, with **New project** (a dialog: name, then a multi-select of workspaces filtered to the forge of the first one picked), **Edit repos** and **Delete**. The Workspaces page shows the "part of project" 409 as its own message.

NOT in this task (later tasks build them, do not start them): opening terminals/agents on a project (`POST /api/terminals { projectId }`, `TerminalInfo.projectId`, the agent buttons on the Projects page — leave room for an actions cell, but add no terminal button); project runs (`project~<id>` run homes, `RunSummary.project`, Start run for a project, a Runs column on the Projects page); sandboxes and Create PR for projects; docs/README (a later docs task).

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `docs/prd/multi-repo.md` — "Decisions" rows on the project folder and `project.json`; "Engine: the project manifest (MR-04)" (the `project.json` format and name rules the engine will validate); "graph-manager: projects (MR-01)"; acceptance criteria "graph-manager" 1–3.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.ts` (lines 8–92 schema and types; 141–168 `reviewers()`, `get()`, `update()`) — add the `projects` field and a `projects()` reader in the same style.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/workspaces.ts` (lines 5–87) — `Workspace { id, path, rel, forge, fullPath }`, `listWorkspaces` (skips dot folders, line 48, so `.projects/` is never listed as a workspace), `resolveWorkspace(root, id)`, `insideWorkspaces(root, p)`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/workspaces.ts` (lines 106–139 `liveRunIn`; 302–311 `DELETE /api/workspaces/:id`) — the live-run check to share and the DELETE to extend.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/app.ts` (lines 10–36 imports, 144–157 "feature routes (one line per feature)") — register `projectRoutes`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/agents.ts` (lines 221–229 `git()` helper with `reject: false`) — the git-call pattern.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/test-helpers.ts` (lines 1–61) — `tempDir`, `testConfig` (workspaces in `<dir>/ws`), `appWithLogin()` returning `{ app, cookie, config, store, cleanup }`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/workspaces.test.ts` (lines 1–36, 95–155) — test layout; lines 142–148 make a run look live by writing `.graph-execution/r/lock` with `${process.pid}\ntoken\n`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.test.ts` (lines 83–97) — "opens an old file without the sandbox keys with their defaults".
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/App.tsx` (lines 7–13 imports, 69–78 routes), `src/web/Shell.tsx` (line 28 `CHORD`, lines 170–184 nav items), `src/web/CommandPalette.tsx` (lines 50–56 page and action entries), `src/web/ui/Icon.tsx` (lines 3–31 `IconName`, 32–124 `PATHS`).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Workspaces.tsx` (whole file, 330 lines) and `pages/Workspaces.css` (lines 1–50, 100–120) — the list page to copy: header with count + filter + primary button, `ws-table` grid rows, `ForgeChip`, `EmptyState`, `SkeletonRows`, `ConfirmDialog`, `useToast`, delete flow (lines 109–140).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Terminals.tsx` (lines 676–797 `NewTerminalDialog`) — a form dialog on `.dialog-overlay`/`.dialog` with `useFocusTrap`, `field`/`field-label`/`field-error` classes, Esc, busy state; `pages/Terminals.css:176` sizes it.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/ui/Dialog.tsx` (lines 1–69), `ui/focus.ts`, `api.ts` (lines 1–44: `api`, `post(path, body, method)`, `ApiError { status, error }`).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/types.ts` (lines 36–78) — add the `ProjectEntry` type here.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Workspaces.test.tsx` (lines 1–190 render helper and `fakeApi`; 249–273 delete tests) and `src/web/Shell.test.tsx` (lines 60–95 helpers; 127–143 nav order test; 176–230 palette/chords).

## Patterns to follow

**Data shapes (use exactly these names):**

```ts
// src/server/projects.ts
export const PROJECTS_DIR = ".projects";
export const PROJECT_FILE = "project.json";
export interface Project { id: string; name: string; workspaces: string[]; createdAt: string }
/** `<workspacesDir>/.projects/<id>` (absolute). */
export function projectDirOf(workspacesDir: string, id: string): string {
  return path.join(path.resolve(workspacesDir), PROJECTS_DIR, id);
}
```

Store (`store.ts`), next to `workspaceSettings`:
```ts
/** Projects (docs/prd/multi-repo.md): named groups of workspaces of one forge. Key: the project id (the name's slug). */
projects: z
  .record(z.string(), z.object({ name: z.string(), workspaces: z.array(z.string()), createdAt: z.string() }))
  .default({}),
```
and on `DataStore`: `projects(): Project[]` (sorted by name, `{ id, ...rec }`) and `project(id: string): Project | undefined`. Writes go through the existing `update(fn)`.

**Name and id**: the name must match `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$` (the engine's `project.json` rule, spec "Engine: the project manifest"), else 400 `invalid project name: use letters, digits, - and _`. The id is `name.toLowerCase().replace(/_/g, "-")` (so `[a-z0-9-]+`, never `~` or `.`). A second project with the same id is 409 `a project named <existing name> already exists`.

**Repo (link) names**: the workspace's last `fullPath` segment with every character outside `[A-Za-z0-9_-]` replaced by `-` (the engine requires `[A-Za-z0-9_-]+`), then `-2`, `-3`, … on a clash, in the order of the request. On PATCH, a workspace already in the project keeps the name it has in the current `project.json`; only added workspaces get new names. Export it: `export function repoNamesOf(workspaces: Workspace[], keep: Map<string /*ws id*/, string /*name*/> = new Map()): Map<string, string>`.

**git calls** (copy `agents.ts:224-229`):
```ts
async function git(cwd: string, args: string[]) {
  const res = await execa("git", args, { cwd, env: { ...process.env, GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: "0" }, reject: false, stdin: "ignore" });
  return { ok: res.exitCode === 0, stdout: String(res.stdout ?? "").trim(), stderr: String(res.stderr ?? "").trim() };
}
```

**Route module** shape (like `routes/reviewers.ts` / `routes/terminals.ts`):
```ts
export async function projectRoutes(app: FastifyInstance, ctx: AppContext): Promise<void> {
  const root = path.resolve(ctx.config.workspacesDir);
  app.get("/api/projects", async () => ({ projects: ctx.store.projects().map((p) => viewOf(root, p)) }));
  ...
}
```
The view (also the body of POST 201 and PATCH 200):
```ts
interface ProjectView { id: string; name: string; forge: string; path: string /* projectDirOf */; createdAt: string;
  workspaces: { id: string; fullPath: string; repo: string /* its name under repos/ */ }[] }
```
`GET` wraps the list as `{ projects: ProjectView[] }` (every list route here wraps: `{ workspaces, root }`, `{ terminals }`). `repo` comes from the folder's `project.json` (fall back to `repoNamesOf` when it can't be read); `fullPath` from `resolveWorkspace`, or `id.split("~").slice(1).join("/")` when the workspace is gone.

Body validation errors use zod + the app's error handler (`app.ts:105-110` turns a `ZodError` into 400 `{ error: "<path>: <message>" }`); other errors `reply.code(n).send({ error })`.

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: the `projects` field and `projects()` / `project(id)` readers above. Import the `Project` type from `./projects.js` as `import type` (no runtime cycle).
- **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/store`

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/liverun.ts`; UPDATE `routes/workspaces.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: move `liveRunIn` (routes/workspaces.ts:106–139) unchanged into `liverun.ts` as `export async function liveRunIn(ctx: AppContext, home: { id: string; path: string }): Promise<boolean>` (it only uses `ws.id` for the sandbox records and `ws.path` for `.graph-execution/`; a `Workspace` still fits). Import it back in `routes/workspaces.ts`. For a project, call it with `{ id: \`project~${id}\`, path: projectDirOf(root, id) }` (a later task records project sandboxes under `project~<id>`).
- **IMPORTS**: `import type { AppContext } from "./app.js"` (type only), `readLock` from `graph-execution/api`.

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/projects.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `PROJECTS_DIR`, `PROJECT_FILE`, `Project`, `projectDirOf`, `repoNamesOf` (above), `projectIdOf(name)`, `PROJECT_NAME = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/`.
  - `readProjectFile(dir): Promise<{ name: string; repos: { name: string; path: string }[] } | undefined>` (undefined when missing/invalid).
  - `createProjectFolder(workspacesDir: string, project: Project, workspaces: Workspace[]): Promise<void>`:
    1. `dir = projectDirOf(...)`; if it exists → throw `ProjectFolderError(409, "project folder <dir> already exists")` (a class like `AgentPrepareError`, `agents.ts:210-217`).
    2. `mkdir(dir, { recursive: true })`; `git init -q -b main`.
    3. Git identity: if `git config user.email` (resolved from global/system) prints nothing, set local `user.name graph-manager` and `user.email graph-manager@localhost` in the new repo (the Docker image sets `GIT_*` env, a laptop has a global identity; CI may have neither, and later the engine and Qwen Code commit in this folder too).
    4. write `project.json` (`JSON.stringify({ name, repos }, null, 2) + "\n"`, repos in request order, `path: "repos/<name>"` with `/`), `.gitignore` (`"repos/\n.graph-execution/\n"`), `mkdir repos/`, and one link per workspace: `await symlink(ws.path, path.join(dir, "repos", name), process.platform === "win32" ? "junction" : "dir")`.
    5. `git add -- project.json .gitignore` and `git commit -q -m "chore: create project <name>"`.
    6. On any failure after step 2: `removeProjectFolder(...)` then rethrow (a failed commit → `ProjectFolderError(500, "git commit failed: <last line>")`).
  - `syncProjectFolder(workspacesDir, project, workspaces)`: names via `repoNamesOf(workspaces, keep)` where `keep` comes from the current `project.json`; remove links whose workspace left (unlink, see GOTCHA), add links for new ones, rewrite `project.json`, `git add -- project.json` and commit `chore: update project repos` only when `git status --porcelain -- project.json` is non-empty. If the folder is missing, recreate it with `createProjectFolder`.
  - `removeProjectFolder(workspacesDir, id)`: first remove every entry of `repos/` that `lstat` reports as a symbolic link with `rm(link)` (no `recursive`), then `rm(dir, { recursive: true, force: true, maxRetries: 10, retryDelay: 100 })`.
- **GOTCHA (Windows)**: use `path.join` everywhere and `/` only inside `project.json`. `fs.symlink(target, p, "junction")` needs an absolute target (`ws.path` is absolute) and no admin rights. Node's `lstat` reports a junction as `isSymbolicLink()`, and `fs.rm` without `recursive` on a link removes the link only. Removing the links before `rm -r` makes sure a recursive delete can never walk into a workspace.
- **GOTCHA**: the workspace and its link must both be inside `workspacesDir` — `insideWorkspaces(root, linkPath)` resolves symlinks, so do not use it on links; check workspaces with `resolveWorkspace` instead.

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/projects.ts`; UPDATE `app.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `GET /api/projects` → `{ projects: ProjectView[] }`.
  - `POST /api/projects { name, workspaces }` (zod: `name: z.string().trim()`, `workspaces: z.array(z.string().min(1))`, `.strict()`), checks in this order: bad name → 400 (text above); duplicate ids in `workspaces` → 400 `a workspace is listed twice`; fewer than 2 → 400 `a project needs at least 2 workspaces`; an id `resolveWorkspace` rejects → 404 `unknown workspace <id>`; two forges (`ws.forge`) → 400 `all workspaces of a project must come from one forge`; id in use, or a create of the same id in flight (keep a `Set` of reserved ids, claimed before any await, like `reserved` in routes/workspaces.ts:184–187) → 409. Then `createProjectFolder`, then `ctx.store.update((d) => { d.projects[id] = { name, workspaces, createdAt } })`; if the store write fails, remove the folder. 201 with the view.
  - `PATCH /api/projects/:id { workspaces }`: 404 `project not found`; the same workspace checks; `await liveRunIn(ctx, …)` → 409 `a run of this project is live`; `syncProjectFolder`; store update; 200 view.
  - `DELETE /api/projects/:id`: 404; live → 409 `a run of this project is live`; close the terminals whose `cwd` is the project folder or inside it (`ctx.terminals.list()` / `remove`, as routes/workspaces.ts:306–308 does — compare with `path.resolve` and `startsWith(dir + path.sep)`); `removeProjectFolder`; delete the record; 204.
  - `app.ts`: `import { projectRoutes } from "./routes/projects.js"` and `await projectRoutes(app, ctx);` after `workspaceRoutes`.
- **GOTCHA**: everything under `/api/` already requires the session cookie (`auth.ts` hook); no auth code here, but test the 401.

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/workspaces.ts` (DELETE, lines 302–311)
- **IMPLEMENT**: after the 404 check and before the live-run check: `const p = ctx.store.projects().find((x) => x.workspaces.includes(ws.id)); if (p) return reply.code(409).send({ error: \`workspace is part of project ${p.name}\` });`

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/projects.test.ts` and `routes/projects.test.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT** (`appWithLogin()`; workspaces made with `git init -q -b main` in `<config.workspacesDir>/github/octo/api`, `github/octo/web`, `gitlab/grp/lib`, `github/other/api`, `github/octo/my.app`; no forge needed):
  - unit: `repoNamesOf` → `api`, `api-2` for `octo/api` + `other/api`; `my.app` → `my-app`; `keep` wins. `projectIdOf("Billing_v2")` → `billing-v2`.
  - `POST` with one workspace → 400; GitHub + GitLab → 400 `all workspaces of a project must come from one forge`; unknown id → 404; name `bad name!` → 400; 2 GitHub → 201 with `{ id: "billing", name: "billing", forge: "github", path, workspaces: [{ id, fullPath, repo }] }`; then `<ws>/.projects/billing/project.json` equals `{ name: "billing", repos: [{ name: "api", path: "repos/api" }, { name: "web", path: "repos/web" }] }`, `realpathSync(repos/api) === realpathSync(<ws>/github/octo/api)`, `.gitignore` is `repos/\n.graph-execution/\n`, `git log --format=%s` is `chore: create project billing`, `git status --porcelain` is empty; a second POST `Billing` → 409; `GET /api/workspaces` still lists only the real workspaces (no `.projects`).
  - `GET /api/projects` → `{ projects: [view] }`; without the cookie → 401.
  - `PATCH` adding `other/api` → its link is `api-2`, `api` keeps its name, a new commit `chore: update project repos`; removing `web` removes `repos/web` but `<ws>/github/octo/web` still exists; PATCH with a live lock in `<project>/.graph-execution/r/lock` (`${process.pid}\ntoken\n`) → 409.
  - `DELETE /api/workspaces/github~octo~api` while in the project → 409 `workspace is part of project billing`.
  - `DELETE /api/projects/billing` with a live lock → 409; after removing the lock → 204, the folder is gone, both workspaces and their files still exist, `GET /api/projects` is empty, and the workspace DELETE now gives 204.
  - store.test.ts: an old file without `projects` opens with `projects: {}`.
- **PATTERN**: `routes/workspaces.test.ts:142-148` (live lock), `store.test.ts:83-97`.
- **GOTCHA**: do not `describe.skipIf(win32)`: junctions work on the Windows CI runner. Commit in tests with the project folder's own identity (the code sets one when none is configured); never rely on the developer's global git config.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/projects src/server/routes/projects src/server/routes/workspaces src/server/store`

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/types.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `export interface ProjectEntry { id: string; name: string; forge: string; path: string; createdAt: string; workspaces: { id: string; fullPath: string; repo: string }[] }` with a doc comment `GET /api/projects → { projects }`.

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Projects.tsx`, `pages/Projects.css`, `pages/ProjectDialog.tsx`
- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - Page `section.page.projects-page` (`data-testid="page-projects"`), header like Workspaces (`h1` "Projects" + mono count, spacer, primary **New project** button `data-testid="project-new"`; `?new=1` opens the dialog, as `?clone=1` does on Workspaces lines 63–79).
  - Data: `GET /api/projects` on mount and after each change (a small `load()` in the page; not in `overview.tsx`); workspaces from `useOverview().workspaces`.
  - Table `pj-table` with grid rows like `ws-row`: Forge (`ForgeChip`), Project (`strong.mono` name + `span.mono` folder path), Repos (one `chip mono` per repo: `repo` name, `title` = fullPath), Actions (right aligned: **Edit repos** `data-testid="project-edit-<id>"`, a trash button `data-testid="project-delete-<id>"` with `aria-label="Delete <name>"`). Leave the actions cell a flex row so a later task can add agent buttons before **Edit repos**.
  - Empty states: fewer than 2 workspaces → `EmptyState` "Clone at least two repositories first" with a link to `/workspaces`; else "No projects yet" with **New project**. Loading → `SkeletonRows`. A load error → an inline `role="alert"` line with Retry.
  - Delete: `ConfirmDialog` tone danger, title `Delete project <name>?`, body `This removes the project folder <path> with its specs, tasks and runs. The workspaces stay.`; success → toast `Deleted <name>`; error (e.g. 409 a run is live) → toast `Couldn’t delete <name>: <error>`.
  - `ProjectDialog` (`mode: "new" | "edit"`), built like `NewTerminalDialog` (Terminals.tsx:676–797: `.dialog-overlay`, `form.dialog`, `useFocusTrap`, Esc cancels, busy button, `field-error` with the server's `ApiError.error`): **Name** input (`data-testid="project-name"`, read-only in edit mode) with the hint "Letters, digits, - and _. The folder is .projects/<id>." and a client-side check of the same regex; **Repositories**: a `fieldset` of checkboxes, one per workspace (`data-testid="project-ws-<id>"`, label `fullPath`, a `ForgeChip`). Once one is checked, workspaces of other forges are hidden and a hint says "Only <forge> workspaces: a project uses one forge connection." Submit (**Create** / **Save**) is disabled until the name is valid and 2+ are checked; it POSTs/PATCHes, closes, toasts `Created <name>` / `Saved <name>` and reloads. Order of the selected workspaces = the order they were checked (that is the `project.json` order).
  - `Projects.css`: tokens only, copy `Workspaces.css` structure (`.pj-table-wrap`, `.pj-row` grid `72px minmax(200px, 1fr) minmax(200px, 2fr) auto`, a two-line card layout under 900px) and a `.project-dialog` width `min(520px, calc(100vw - 32px))` with a scrollable checkbox list (`max-height: 50vh; overflow: auto`).
- **PATTERN**: `pages/Workspaces.tsx:59-330`, `pages/Workspaces.css:1-50,100-120`, `pages/Terminals.tsx:676-797`.

### UPDATE `App.tsx`, `Shell.tsx`, `CommandPalette.tsx`, `ui/Icon.tsx`, `pages/Workspaces.tsx`
- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `App.tsx`: `<Route path="/projects" element={<Projects />} />` after `/workspaces`.
  - `ui/Icon.tsx`: add `"projects"` to `IconName` and a stroke path to `PATHS` (e.g. two stacked folders on the 16×16 grid, `currentColor`).
  - `Shell.tsx`: `<NavItem to="/projects" icon="projects" label="Projects" />` right after Workspaces (line 176); `CHORD` gets `p: "/projects"`.
  - `CommandPalette.tsx`: page `{ id: "p:projects", group: "Pages", icon: "projects", label: "Projects", secondary: "page", to: "/projects" }` after Workspaces, action `{ id: "a:project", group: "Actions", icon: "plus", label: "New project", secondary: "action", to: "/projects?new=1" }`.
  - `pages/Workspaces.tsx` `remove()` (lines 114–140): when the error is an `ApiError` with status 409 and `err.error` starts with `workspace is part of project`, close the dialog and toast `Couldn’t delete <fullPath>: <err.error>` (tone `bad`) instead of opening the "Can’t delete … yet" live-run dialog; any other 409 keeps today's behaviour.
- **GOTCHA**: `Shell.test.tsx:131` asserts the nav order `["Runs", "Terminals", "Workspaces", "Reviewers", "Settings"]` — update it to include `"Projects"` after `"Workspaces"`. The chord `g p` must not break `g s`/`g v`/`g w` tests.

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Projects.test.tsx`; UPDATE `Shell.test.tsx`, `pages/Workspaces.test.tsx`
- **IMPLEMENT** (jsdom; copy the `renderPage` + `fakeApi` structure of `Workspaces.test.tsx:1-190`, answering `/api/projects` GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE from an in-memory list):
  - lists a project with its forge chip, folder and repo chips; empty states for 0–1 workspaces and for no projects;
  - New project: type a name, check `github~octo~api` → the GitLab workspace disappears from the list; Create is disabled with one checked and enabled with two; Create POSTs `{ name, workspaces: [api, web] }` in check order, closes, toasts and shows the row; a 409 from the server shows its error inside the dialog, which stays open;
  - `?new=1` opens the dialog;
  - Edit repos PATCHes the new list; Delete asks `Delete project billing?`, sends DELETE and toasts `Deleted billing`;
  - Shell: nav order includes Projects, `g` then `p` goes to `/projects`, the palette offers "Projects";
  - Workspaces: a DELETE answering 409 `workspace is part of project billing` shows a toast with that text and no "Can’t delete … yet" dialog (keep the existing 409 test, which answers `a run is live in this workspace`, passing).
- **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/web`

## Look at it in a browser (TESTING.md: UI changes must be seen)

Start graph-manager as in TESTING.md "graph-manager" (temp dirs, `GM_PASSWORD=pw`, a free port). Make two GitHub workspaces and one GitLab one without a forge: `for r in github/octo/api github/octo/web gitlab/grp/lib; do mkdir -p $GM_DIR/ws/$r && git -C $GM_DIR/ws/$r init -q -b main; done`. Then with `agent-browser` (`open`, `snapshot -i`, `click`, `fill`, `screenshot` and read the PNG): log in, open **Projects** from the nav, **New project** → name `billing`, check `octo/api` (the GitLab one disappears), check `octo/web`, **Create**; the row shows `api` and `web`. `ls -l $GM_DIR/ws/.projects/billing/repos` shows the two links; `git -C $GM_DIR/ws/.projects/billing log --oneline` shows one commit. Try deleting `octo/api` on Workspaces (toast "…part of project billing"), then delete the project and check both workspaces remain. Also at 800 px wide (`agent-browser set viewport 800 700`): no horizontal scroll (`eval 'document.documentElement.scrollWidth - innerWidth'` → 0). Report the screenshot paths.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `POST /api/projects` with one workspace → 400; GitHub + GitLab → 400 `all workspaces of a project must come from one forge`; unknown workspace → 404; bad name → 400; a name in use → 409; two GitHub workspaces → 201, and `<workspacesDir>/.projects/<id>/project.json`, `repos/<repo>` (links to the workspaces), `.gitignore` and one commit exist.
- [ ] `PATCH /api/projects/:id` rewrites `project.json` and the links (kept repos keep their names), commits, and answers 409 while a run of the project is live; `DELETE /api/projects/:id` removes the folder only (never a workspace) and answers 409 while a run is live.
- [ ] `DELETE /api/workspaces/:id` of a workspace in a project → 409 `workspace is part of project <name>`.
- [ ] `GET /api/projects` → `{ projects: [{ id, name, forge, path, createdAt, workspaces: [{ id, fullPath, repo }] }] }`; 401 without a session.
- [ ] A `graph-manager.json` without `projects` still loads.
- [ ] The nav shows **Projects** after Workspaces; the page lists projects with their repos; New project (forge-filtered multi-select), Edit repos and Delete work; the Workspaces page shows the "part of project" 409 as a toast.
- [ ] The new server and web tests above exist and pass on Linux (and nothing in them is skipped on Windows); all existing graph-manager tests pass.

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/projects src/server/routes/projects src/server/routes/workspaces src/server/store
npm test -w graph-manager -- src/web
npm test -w graph-manager
```
